body.statement: Under nondegenerate isolation, the construction in \(\texttt{def:tagged-risk-functional}\) equals \(Q_{\ell}=\mathbb E_{\ell}[a_{\ell}a_{\ell}^{\mathsf T}]\) for every \(\ell\). Thus every dense rational RDIM risk matrix is determined by tagged polynomials with tag size at most two and can be reconstructed in \(O(n^3)\) rational operations with polynomial output bit length.
body.justification: The proposition identifies exactly which marked combinatorial moments the algorithm must compute and prevents substitution of an unmarked size law.
body.gap: The published WRI analysis does not recover pair-specific bias and covariance from its isolated-set law.
body.consumer: The matrix is the exact input to the finite-library minimax design certificate.
